**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +18.65%), Materials showing strength. Industrials strong: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +24.85%). Energy/Real Estate participation notable: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +25.42%), EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.63% | 1M: -6.30%), sector 1W -0.24%. Financials weak: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%). Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AVGO POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.68%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology-dominated); style: Growth/Momentum signals from semis but not confirmed by broader Tech internals.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -14.34%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), GM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.72%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%); weakness concentrated in large-cap software/financial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AVGO (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.68%), NVDA (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), EQIX (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%); note MAJOR DIVERGENCE—multiple large names (AVGO, ORCL, TSLA) show 1W up vs 1M down, so treat as tactical momentum, not durable regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) and AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%) offset broad software weakness — MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%); Tech shows internal rotation and potential short-term reversals.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft overall: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -3.87%); Financials lack leadership and contribute to neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Mixed/holding: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +14.85%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%) but TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -14.34%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -6.09%) — sector in internal rotation with pockets of defensive strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals showing consistent strength (CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +25.42%), DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +18.65%)) and reduce exposure to laggard large-cap software and elongated winners (MSFT BELOW TREND, AMZN BELOW TREND); monitor reversal candidates (ORCL POTENTIAL REVERSAL, AVGO POTENTIAL REVERSAL) for tactical entries.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%).  
BEARISH: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (sector 1W +3.10%), Energy (1W +3.04%) and Materials (1W +4.50%) given momentum.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W -0.24%) and Financials (1W -1.03%) remain vulnerable.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) to hold this week’s breakout for continuation; monitor CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%) for follow-through above recent weekly highs; use AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%) prior lows as risk trigger; treat ORCL POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%) weakness in 1M as caution despite short-term bounce.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PFE (+70): PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%) — solid shareholder returns news confirming price strength.  
ADBE (+50): ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%) — bullish alliance headlines but price remains in decline, divergence suggests limited follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-60): ORCL POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%) — negative legal/AI disclosure headlines but 1W bounce; divergence signals distribution risk.  
EQIX (-55): EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%) — negative FFO miss but price still rising, monitor for earnings-flow reprice.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (style mixed / no clear leadership). CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) showing strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (ORCL, AVGO, AVGO/ORCL 1W up vs 1M down) and negative news on select names (ORCL, EQIX) — treat moves as tactical until confirmed.
